# Text App | AI Customer Service Automation Software for Business | Text.com

> Text App is an AI customer service platform designed to help companies deliver automated support experiences. By combining AI agents, live chat, and help desk features, Text App allows businesses to streamline communication, reduce response times, and improve customer satisfaction.

Key Features of Text App:
- AI-First Customer Service - Automate support with AI agents that scale to meet demand while maintaining a human touch.
- Self-Acting AI Agents - AI experts autonomously deliver support, complete tasks, and drive sales conversions.
- Knowledge Hub - Centralized business knowledge powers AI-generated answers and resolutions.
- Customer Data Platform - Personalize replies using unified customer data from every source.
- AI Live Chat - Real-time chat support where AI handles most interactions and escalates when needed.
- Help Desk & Ticketing - Efficiently manage queries with an organized ticket system.
- Multi-Channel Support - Engage customers across multiple platforms.
- Workflows & Automations - Automate tasks and close conversions at scale with cross-app workflows.
- Campaigns & Engagement - Trigger personalized messages for sales, support, or loyalty initiatives.
- Sales & Service Optimization - AI-led support helps with lead nurturing, product onboarding, concierge care, and de-escalation.

## Overview

- [Text](https://www.text.com/): Automate customer service with Text App - an AI-first support platform packed with live chat, help desk, and AI agents. Deliver 24/7 service that scales with demand and handles support at scale.

## Products

- [Text App](https://www.text.com/app): Sign up or log in to start using the Text App web platform - automate customer service, access AI agents, and manage live chat from anywhere.
- [Desktop app](https://www.text.com/product/desktop-app/): Download Text App for macOS or Windows to manage all your customer service in one workspace. Stay focused, work faster, and let AI help when you're away.

## Features

- [AI agent](https://www.text.com/features/ai-agent/): Automate customer support and sales with AI Agent in the Text App. Deliver personalized, on-brand conversations, reduce wait times, and scale with smart, responsive automation.
- [AI live chat](https://www.text.com/features/ai-live-chat/): Text App AI live chat features help you respond instantly, personalize support, and close more deals with automation that takes care of the busywork.
- [AI help desk](https://www.text.com/features/ai-help-desk/): Text App AI help desk features help you manage tickets, collaborate faster, and resolve issues with AI that streamlines the chaos behind customer service.

 Frequently asked questions 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is Text? 
 
 
 
 
Text is customer service software that turns support conversations into revenue. It combines an AI agent that spots buying signals, live chat that closes deals, and a help desk that turns tickets into repeat customers — all in one workspace, built for ecommerce and SaaS teams.
 
 
 
 
 
 What features are included in Text? 
 
 
 
 
Text gives you a full customer service platform in one place, not a pile of add-ons bolted together. Your team gets a shared space for live chat and email, a ticketing system for everything that needs follow-up, and an AI agent that can carry a conversation all the way to a sale on its own. Behind the scenes, Copilot helps your agents draft replies and surface answers fast, while workflows quietly handle the repetitive steps no one wants to do twice. You also get a chat widget for your site, a self-serve knowledge base, customer profiles and analytics, and MCP to connect Text to the AI tools your team already uses. And because every one of these works from the same shared view of the customer, your team is never piecing the story back together from scratch.
 
 
 
 
 
 Do all Text features share the same customer data? 
 
 
 
 
Yes. Every feature in Text works from the same customer data – chats, tickets, orders, history - so your team always sees one customer picture, with no tool-switching and no manual syncing. What you can split is the knowledge each AI runs on: train Copilot on one set to guide your team behind the scenes, and feed the AI agent a separate set for the conversations it runs directly with customers. Same customer record everywhere, two AI brains you shape on your own terms – one source of truth running through your whole customer service platform.
 
 
 
 
 
 What does the AI agent in Text actually do? 
 
 
 
 
The AI agent in Text doesn't just answer questions — it reads a chat and acts on it. It knows your catalog, voice, and rules, so it can recognise a ready-to-buy customer and nudge them toward checkout, win back an abandoned cart, or quietly resolve a support request while you sleep. That's what makes it one of the few ai customer service tools built to close sales, not just deflect tickets. And when a conversation really needs a person, the agent hands it off warm, full context already in hand — so your team never starts cold.
 
 
 
 
 
 Is Text GDPR compliant, and how does it handle data security? 
 
 
 
 
Yes, Text is GDPR compliant and supports CCPA, SOC 2 Type 2, and PCI DSS. Customer data lives in your workspace with role-based access, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logs, and configurable retention. The AI agent only uses your own data — it doesn't train shared models on your conversations.
 
 
 
 
 
 How much does Text cost? 
 
 
 
 
Text pricing starts at $19/user/month (Essential), $79/user/month (Growth), and a custom quote for Enterprise — billed yearly. Annual billing saves up to 24%. Every plan includes the AI agent, live chat, and help desk — higher tiers add more AI resolutions, seats, and enterprise features like SSO and SLAs.
 
 
 
 
 
 What is MCP in Text? 
 
 
 
 
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a secure way to connect AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to your Text data. Point them at your tickets, chats, and transcripts, and ask questions in plain language. Your support history stops being something you dig through and becomes something you can interrogate — right inside the AI tools your team already works in.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Which apps does Text integrate with? 
 
 
 
 
Text integrates with Shopify, Messenger, email, SMS, Salesforce, OpenAI, HubSpot, Slack, Mailchimp, and any website. More integrations are available through the API and MCP, so you can connect Text to the tools your team already uses without custom development.
 
 
 
 
 
 Do I need a developer to set up Text? 
 
 
 
 
No, you don't need a developer to set up Text. The chat widget, knowledge base, and most integrations install without code — usually in under an hour. For deeper customisation, Workflows, MCP, and the API are available when you need them.
 
 
 
 
 
 Does Text offer a free trial? 
 
 
 
 
Yes, Text offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. You get full access to a paid plan during the trial, and your data stays in your workspace if you decide to continue. Pricing starts at $19/user/month after the trial ends.
 
 
 
 
 
 Can I migrate from another help desk to Text? 
 
 
 
 
Yes. Through guided migration, your tickets, contacts, tags, and canned responses move over from major help desk software like Zendesk, Intercom, and Freshdesk. Those historical conversations feed the AI agent's context, so it gets sharper the moment your real data lands in the workspace — and you get a working customer service ticketing system without starting from a blank slate.
 
 
 
 
 
 Can I use Text without the AI agent? 
 
 
 
 
Yes, you can use Text without the AI agent. The AI agent and Copilot are optional layers — Text works as a pure human live chat and help desk too. Routing rules let you decide exactly when AI steps in and when every conversation goes straight to a person.
 
 
 
 
 
 How does Text compare to other AI customer service software? 
 
 
 
 
Most AI customer service tools are built to deflect tickets — they answer simple questions and end there. Text treats AI as one feature inside a full customer service platform, so conversations flow from AI agent to live chat to ticketing without losing context, and success is measured in revenue, not just deflection rate.

 Frequently asked questions 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How much does Text cost? 
 
 
 
 
Text pricing is based on your team size and the level of AI automation you need. There is no fixed one-size-fits-all plan. You start with a free 14-day trial to experience the full platform before committing, and after that, plans are structured around the number of agents and conversation volume your business handles. Contact our team or start your free trial to get a quote matched to your needs.
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a free trial? Do I need a credit card? 
 
 
 
 
Yes. Every Text plan starts with a 14-day free trial, and no credit card is required to get started. During the trial you get full access to 
Text AI Agents
, live chat, 
help desk tools
, and AI Copilot so your team can run real conversations and see results before making any decision.
 
 
 
 
 
 How is help desk software priced? 
 
 
 
 
Help desk software
 is usually priced per user per month, ranging from $10 to $200 depending on features and AI capabilities. Text's help desk pricing follows the same per-user model and includes unlimited tickets in every plan:
Essential:
 $19/user/month — shared inbox, ticketing, AI ticket classification, 3 workflows (300 monthly executions)
Growth:
 $79/user/month — adds tag suggestions, ticket summaries, advanced reporting, 10 workflows (1,000 executions)
Enterprise:
 Custom offer — adds SLAs, a dedicated team that deploys for you, on-demand reporting, audit logs, and custom workflow limits
We don't charge per ticket or per resolution, so scaling support doesn't trigger surprise bills — your costs stay tied to team size, not volume. Yearly billing saves up to 24%. Start free, no credit card required.
 
 
 
 
 
 What is the pricing for an AI chatbot in customer service? 
 
 
 
 
AI chatbot
 pricing ranges from free (basic rule-based bots) to $500+/month (enterprise AI platforms). With Text, the AI chatbot — what we call the AI Agent — is included in every paid plan and priced per license, per month:
Essential:
 $19/user/month — 1 AI Agent, 10 resolutions
Growth:
 $79/user/month — 10 AI Agents, 200 resolutions
Enterprise:
 Custom offer — 50 AI Agents, custom resolutions, built and run for you
We charge per resolution, not per conversation. A resolution counts only when the AI Agent solves at least one customer question — and there's just one charge per co
